movelist.effect: Bug Buzz lowers the Special Defense of all targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Earth Power

movelist.name: Screech

movelist.name: Supersonic

movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

movelist.name: Sand Tomb
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Flutter
abilities.effect: The user gains +3 Evasion until the end of their next turn, and cannot be Flanked.
